figurative_meaning_en: Conspiracy or scheming by a large group of people
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই রাজনৈতিক দলের মধ্যে দশচক্র চলছে।
গ্রামের লোকেরা দশচক্র করে সম্পত্তির বণ্টন করতে চায়।
example_sentences_in_english: There is a lot of scheming going on within this political party.
The villagers are plotting in a web of intrigue to divide the property.
history: The associated proverb 'দশচক্রে ভগবান ভূত' illustrates the idiom, suggesting that even divine power is overwhelmed by multiple layers of human scheming, rooted in traditional Bengali folklore.
note: The idiom often appears in proverbial contexts emphasizing the complexity of group conspiracies.
